pages.text: Use the machine’s structure information to place casings, hatches and other required blocks. Some processes also need particular coils, temperature, maintenance or environmental conditions.

If a multiblock will not form, inspect the structure before changing the recipe. If it forms but will not run, inspect the operating requirements and every input and output.$(br2)Ready for the next tier: you can sustain the current one and have identified the new material or process that actually opens the next project.
